scientific_fronts.title: Chemical, stereochemical, botanical, commercial-grade and stock identity
scientific_fronts.requirement: Exact identities, admitted aliases, carriers/bases, source conflicts and separation of target from build

scientific_fronts.title: GC-MS, GC-O, recombination and omission/addition
scientific_fronts.requirement: Peak amount is not sensory importance; unknown constituents and unknown odor events retained

scientific_fronts.title: Equilibrium, finite release, delivery and substrate
scientific_fronts.requirement: Matrix/geometry/time-specific mass conservation; no missing-property defaults

scientific_fronts.title: Detection and human gas-dose intensity
scientific_fronts.requirement: Compatible OAV diagnostic; admitted exact gas curves; corrected threshold equation; separate mixture challengers

scientific_fronts.title: Concentration-aware character and temporal identity
scientific_fronts.requirement: Simple profile baseline first; endpoint/coverage limits and human labels

scientific_fronts.title: Population pleasantness and personal preference
scientific_fronts.requirement: Independent human labels, individual variability, blinded protocol and explicit ties

scientific_fronts.title: Brand, familiarity, language, packaging and context
scientific_fronts.requirement: Separate blinded sensory result from branded consumer concept/market response

scientific_fronts.title: Experiment design and conservative optimization
scientific_fronts.requirement: Leakage-safe splits, equal-budget random/local/adaptive arms, Pareto endpoints and selected-outcome metrics

scientific_fronts.title: Solubility, crystallization, oxidation and packaging
scientific_fronts.requirement: Exact product/matrix behavior and measured homogeneity; no universal shelf-life/solubility claim

scientific_fronts.title: Safety/regulatory and supplier documentation
scientific_fronts.requirement: Independent current reviewed policy, exact limits/aliases and finished-product assessment; never creative beauty authority

scientific_fronts.title: Mass, mainstream/prestige, niche and regional positioning
scientific_fronts.requirement: Time/region/channel/franchise scope; no sales-derived liking label

scientific_fronts.title: Delivery formats and use scenarios
scientific_fronts.requirement: Hydroalcoholic EDP/EDT, oil, solid, mist, hair/textile and functional matrices are not interchangeable

scientific_fronts.title: Offline retrieval, versioning, compiler and deterministic execution
scientific_fronts.requirement: Exact fingerprints, explicit source/review states, no runtime web calls and focused tests

scientific_fronts.title: Measurable compounding and evolving-bottle workflow
scientific_fronts.requirement: µL liquids/mg solids, proper stock arithmetic, additive-only deltas, no duplicate transfer and proportionate questions

market_segments.title: Broad-distribution value/mass fragrance
market_segments.scope: Region/channel/price-period evidence required; not inferred from a scent family

market_segments.title: Accessible aspirational positioning
market_segments.scope: Define relative to the selected market, not a universal price threshold

market_segments.title: Luxury house/collection positioning
market_segments.scope: Exact collection/product rather than a brand-wide assumption

market_segments.title: Specialist/artisan or selective perfume positioning
market_segments.scope: Not proof of unusual quality or low mass appeal

market_segments.scope: Do not infer proprietary composition, equivalence or licensing from marketing

source_records.title: IFRA transparency list
source_records.applicability_limit: Ingredient palette metadata; not safety approval, ownership or all physicochemical properties.

source_records.title: IFRA standards library
source_records.applicability_limit: Versioned independent safety-policy source; no amendment-effective-date claim made here.

source_records.title: L'Oreal 2025 Luxe annual report
source_records.applicability_limit: Current report selects market anchors; line/franchise scope retained; sales not liking.

source_records.title: L'Oreal 2025 annual results
source_records.applicability_limit: Mainstream couture and collections are distinct positioning; no exact EDP ranking inferred.

source_records.title: Coty Q4 fiscal 2026 results
source_records.applicability_limit: Distinguishes prestige and mass-fragrance portfolios; issuer report, not consumer liking.

source_records.title: LVMH 2025 fragrance report
source_records.applicability_limit: Current text states Sauvage men's-fragrance position; not all fragrances or one exact flanker.

source_records.title: Arshamian et al. cross-cultural pleasantness
source_records.applicability_limit: Monomolecular ranking and individual variation, not finished-perfume market prediction.

source_records.title: Lenochova et al. fragrance/body-odor interactions
source_records.applicability_limit: Individual interactions; not automatic skin-versus-blotter transfer.

source_records.title: Ma et al. binary-mixture pleasantness
source_records.applicability_limit: Binary study with observed component sensations; do not relabel as formula-only 60-row prediction.

source_records.title: Drnovsek et al. 909 individuals/16 regions
source_records.applicability_limit: Separate intensity, pleasantness and other descriptors; stimulus and population applicability need full-method review.

source_records.title: de Araujo et al. cognitive odor-label effects
source_records.applicability_limit: Supports keeping blinded sensory and branded concept response separate, not a brand-success coefficient.

source_records.title: Dharmawan et al. orange peel reconstitution/omission
source_records.applicability_limit: Exact peel product/method domain; not a transferable complete perfume recipe.

source_records.title: Zhang et al. Jasminum sambac concrete
source_records.applicability_limit: No quantitative data admission; requires primary full-text/source and license review before implementation.

source_records.title: Wakayama 2020 correction
source_records.applicability_limit: Gas-unit equation scope; algebra is not human validity.

source_records.title: Johnson et al. GC recomposition olfactometry
source_records.applicability_limit: Recombination method precedent; do not infer whole-perfume liking.

source_records.title: Trabucco et al. conservative objective models
source_records.applicability_limit: Offline optimization support/extrapolation control; perfume endpoint validation still required.

source_records.title: Tan et al. offline optimization by learning to rank
source_records.applicability_limit: Selected-outcome/ranking evaluation rationale; not an admitted perfume optimizer.

source_records.title: Retraction: Social success of perfumes
source_records.applicability_limit: Original DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0218664 rejected for reproducibility/data-availability issues.

source_records.title: Pellegrino et al. 2026 linear mixture character preprint
source_records.applicability_limit: 432 mixtures; 144 concentration-specific component profiles from 115 molecular odorants; 2-10 components and moderate intensities. No validated 63-stock drydown or global liking claim.

source_records.title: Sisson et al. 2025 deep learning for aroma-chemical blends
source_records.applicability_limit: Labeled molecular pairs, not a dose-dependent complete-perfume liking model. Direct PMC open returned a browser check; full methods, split and artifact rights review remain pending.

source_records.title: Lee et al. 2023 Principal Odor Map
source_records.applicability_limit: Prospective single-molecule descriptor prediction. Mixture, concentration adapter, proprietary product identity and liking require separate evaluation.

source_records.title: Teixeira et al. fragrance diffusion prediction and validation
source_records.applicability_limit: Controlled diffusion-tube systems up to eleven chemicals. Not blanket skin/sillage validation; full parameters and methods review pending.

source_records.title: Costa et al. fragrance release from simplified DPG matrix
source_records.applicability_limit: One to four fragrance ingredients in DPG. Partition convention and exact matrix apply; do not transfer DPG coefficients to ethanol/water EDP.

source_records.title: Almeida et al. evaporation and permeation applied to skin
source_records.applicability_limit: Finite/infinite dosing of alpha-pinene, limonene and linalool in ethanol with porcine-skin Franz cells. Not complete human-perfume performance or safety validation.

source_records.title: Almeida et al. radial fragrance diffusion prediction and validation
source_records.applicability_limit: Pure, binary and ternary controlled systems with parameterized UNIFAC; source physical concentration validation does not validate repository Hansen or universal Stevens intensity.

source_records.title: Calkin and Jellinek, Perfumery: Practice and Principles
source_records.applicability_limit: 1994 historical training/composition reference. Chapters not read here; law, palette and commercial editions require fresh sources.

source_records.title: dsm-firmenich exact ingredient and extraction resources
source_records.applicability_limit: Manufacturer product/extraction descriptors, not independent empirical liking or all-material stock availability. Exact product documents still required.
